sys_remote_update_set.description:
3. Public Transport Complaint & Safety System Real problem: Commuters face unsafe buses/trains and poor service, but complaints vanish. Solution in ServiceNow:
Table for Transport Complaints (unsafe driving, overcrowding, harassment).
Workflow routes complaints to transport authority.
SLA ensures response within 48 hours.
Dashboard shows complaint trends by route. Impact: Improves commuter safety and accountability. CSA features used: Tables, SLAs, Workflows, Reports.
sys_remote_update_set.name: Public Transport Complaint & Safety System

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Analytics center">b71bc55a9309c390b66436718bba10cc</macroponent><name>onPageLoad</name><preset/><required_translations>[
    {
        "message": "Bookmarked"
    },
    {
        "message": "created_by_me_lowercase"
    },
    {
        "message": "All"
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
async function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    if (api.context.app.appId == "08c73d60537101100834ddeeff7b1287") {
        helpers.timing.setTimeout(function() {
            const ux_globals = this.ux_globals;
            function routeExists(page) {
                if (ux_globals) {
                    const experienceURL = ux_globals.siteName;
                    const currentExperienceConfig = ux_globals.experienceConfigs[experienceURL];
                    const appRouteConfiguration = currentExperienceConfig ? currentExperienceConfig.appRouteConfiguration : null;
                    if (appRouteConfiguration && appRouteConfiguration.routes && typeof appRouteConfiguration.routes === 'object') {
                        const routes = Object.keys(appRouteConfiguration.routes) || [];
                        if (routes.includes(page)) {
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                };
                return false;
            }

            var page = api.context.props.tab;
            if (page == "1" && routeExists("dashboard-library")) {
                api.emit("NAV_ITEM_SELECTED", {
                    route: "dashboard-library",
                    params: {
                        filter: api.context.props.filter,
                    }
                });
            } else if (page == "2" && routeExists("data-visualization-library")) {
                api.emit("NAV_ITEM_SELECTED", {
                    route: "data-visualization-library",
                    params: {
                        filter: api.context.props.filter,
                    }
                });
            } else if (page == "3" && routeExists("kpi-library")) {
                api.emit("NAV_ITEM_SELECTED", {
                    route: "kpi-library",
                    params: {
                        filter: api.context.props.filter,
                    }
                });
            } else {
                api.emit("NAV_ITEM_SELECTED", {
                    route: "analytics-center-home"
                });
            }
        });
        return;
    }

    api.setState('selectedTabIndex', api.context.props.tab);
    const tab = api.context.props.tab || 0;
    switch (tab ) {
        case 1:
        case '1': api.setState('dashboardFilter', api.context.props.filter);
            break;
        case 2:
        case '2': api.setState('predefinedFilterType', api.context.props.filter);
            break;
        case 3:
        case '3': api.setState('kpiFilter', api.context.props.filter);
            break;
    }

    api.setState('kpiCategoryList', [, {
        "id": "bookmarked",
        "label": await helpers.translate("Bookmarked")
    }, {
        "id": "created_by_me",
        "label": await helpers.translate("created_by_me_lowercase")
    }, {
        "id": "all",
        "label": await helpers.translate("All")
    }]);
}
]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-05-26 11:29:38</sys_created_on><sys_id>c82bc55a9309c390b66436718bba10f5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>onPageLoad</sys_name><sys_package display_value="canvas" source="x_1896917_canvas">9a518c3993b00310b66436718bba108b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="canvas">9a518c3993b00310b66436718bba108b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_c82bc55a9309c390b66436718bba10f5</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-05-26 11:29:38</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Analytics center">b71bc55a9309c390b66436718bba10cc</macroponent><name>button_1/isHidden</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
  * @param {params} params
  * @param {api} params.api
  * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
  */
function evaluateProperty({api, helpers}) {
  const userRoles = api.context.session.user.roles;
  if (userRoles && (userRoles.includes("admin") || userRoles.includes("viz_creator") || userRoles.includes("viz_admin")))
    return false;

	return true;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-05-26 11:29:38</sys_created_on><sys_id>042bc55a9309c390b66436718bba10f1</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>button_1/isHidden</sys_name><sys_package display_value="canvas" source="x_1896917_canvas">9a518c3993b00310b66436718bba108b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="canvas">9a518c3993b00310b66436718bba108b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_042bc55a9309c390b66436718bba10f1</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-05-26 11:29:38</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_1896917_canvas_public_transport_complaints</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>PTC preventing duplicacy</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

	// Add your code here
	var gr=new GlideRecord('x_1896917_canvas_public_transport_complaints');
	gr.addQuery('complaint_type',current.complaint_type);
	gr.addQuery('complaint_location',current.complaint_location);
	gr.addQuery('status','!=','Closed');
	gr.addQuery('commuter_name',current.commuter_name);
	gr.addQuery('email',current.email);
	gr.query();

	gs.info('Duplicate Check Count = ' + gr.getRowCount());
	gs.info('Complaint Type = ' + current.complaint_type);
gs.info('Location = ' + current.location);
gs.info('duplicate record created.')
	
	if(gr.next()){
		var reportergr= new GlideRecord('x_1896917_canvas_ptc_reporter');
		reportergr.initialize();
		reportergr.complaint=gr.sys_id;
		reportergr.reporter=gs.getUserID();
		reportergr.reported_on=new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValue();
		reportergr.remarks='Duplicate Compliant Reported';
		reportergr.insert();
		var count= parseInt(gr.duplicate_count || 1,10);
		gr.duplicate_count=count +1;
		gr.work_notes='Duplicate compliant attempt detected. Count increased to ' + gr.duplicate_count;
		gr.update();
		gs.addInfoMessage('A similar complaint already exists('+ gr.number +'). Your complaint has been linked to the existing record.');
		current.setAbortAction(true);
	}

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-06-08 07:48:52</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>1105d396935dc314b66436718bba1039</sys_id><sys_mod_count>5</sys_mod_count><sys_name>PTC preventing duplicacy</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="canvas" source="x_1896917_canvas">9a518c3993b00310b66436718bba108b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="canvas">9a518c3993b00310b66436718bba108b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_1105d396935dc314b66436718bba1039</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-06-08 10:26:44</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=1105d396935dc314b66436718bba1039"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_ux_client_script_c82bc55a9309c390b66436718bba10ec
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes>59c9674460031110f87729648b07b76b</includes><macroponent display_value="Analytics center">b71bc55a9309c390b66436718bba10cc</macroponent><name>Update URL Params</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/*** @param {params} params*
 * @param {api} params.api*
 * @param {any} params.event*
 * @param {any} params.imports*
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers*/
function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
	// do not perform anything on PAE pages, as we redirect to 'analytics-center-home'
    if (api.context.app.appId == "08c73d60537101100834ddeeff7b1287") {
        return;
    }
	const acceptedDashboardFilters = ['recent', 'bookmarked', 'certified', 'created_by_me', 'shared_with_me', 'none'];
	const acceptedVizFilters = ['all', 'bookmarked', 'certified', 'created_by_me', 'shared_with_me'];
	const acceptedKpiFilters = api.state.kpiCategoryList.map(e => e.id);
	let currentFilter;
	switch(api.state.selectedTabIndex) {
		case '1':
		case 1:
			currentFilter = acceptedDashboardFilters.find(e => e === api.state.dashboardFilter) || 'recent';
			if(api.state.dashboardFilter !== currentFilter) {
				api.setState('dashboardFilter', currentFilter);
			}
			break;
		case '2':
		case 2:
			currentFilter = acceptedVizFilters.find(e => e === api.state.predefinedFilterType) || 'all';
			if(api.state.predefinedFilterType !== currentFilter) {
				api.setState('predefinedFilterType', currentFilter);
			}
			break;
		case '3':
		case 3:
			currentFilter = acceptedKpiFilters.find(e => e === api.state.kpiFilter) || acceptedKpiFilters[0];
			const {reloadListWithFilters} = imports['sn_app_analytics_w.GenerateFilter']();
			const { showBookmarked, filterCondition } = reloadListWithFilters(currentFilter, api.state.kpiSearchTerm, api.context.session.user.userName);
			if(api.state.kpiFilter !== currentFilter || api.state.filterCondition !== api.state.filterCondition || api.state.showBookmarked !== showBookmarked) {
				api.setState('kpiFilter', currentFilter);
				api.setState('showBookmarked', showBookmarked);
				api.setState('filterCondition', filterCondition);
			}
			break;
	}
	api.emit("CONTENT_UPDATED", {params: {tab: api.state.selectedTabIndex, filter: currentFilter,}});
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-05-26 11:29:38</sys_created_on><sys_id>c82bc55a9309c390b66436718bba10ec</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Update URL Params</sys_name><sys_package display_value="canvas" source="x_1896917_canvas">9a518c3993b00310b66436718bba108b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="canvas">9a518c3993b00310b66436718bba108b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_c82bc55a9309c390b66436718bba10ec</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-05-26 11:29:38</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
